value: I am a Senior Site Reliability Engineer with 8 years running Kubernetes on AWS at scale, most recently as Senior SRE at Acme Cloud in Zurich since 2022. I run 400 microservices on Kubernetes (AWS EKS). With Datadog and OpenTelemetry I cut incident time by 40 percent. I built the Terraform platform used by 120 engineers and led an on-call rotation of 8 people. Before that, as a Platform Engineer at Beta Systems in Berlin, I migrated 60 services to Kubernetes and introduced SLOs and error budgets. I am looking for a reliability or platform role where I can apply the same approach: measure what matters, automate the platform, and keep incident response tight.
